newsitem.title: USA: IPO HIGHLIGHTS-APT flat in heavy trading.
newsitem.headline: IPO HIGHLIGHTS-APT flat in heavy trading.

text.p: Shares of Asia Pacific satellite provider APT Satellite Holdings Inc closed flat at their initial public offering price of $14 after the company's market debut on the New York Stock Exchange.

The company, incorporated in Bermuda, offered 105 million shares in a global offering with 52.5 million shares offered in the United States and Canada and 10.5 million offered in Hong Kong. The ADRs were priced at US $14 each, below their estimated pricing range of $16 to $20.
Over four million shares were traded on Tuesday, making the stock one of the most active on the NYSE.
Other companies that made their IPO debuts today:
-- Mastech Corp shares rose 2-1/8 to 17-1/8 from their IPO price of $15 a share, the middle of its estimated pricing range. The company provides information technology services.
-- Titan Exploration Inc shares rose 1-1/4 to 12-1/4 from their IPO price of $11. Its price talk had been between $9.50 and $11.50.
The Midland, Texas company is an independent energy company engaged in the exploration, development and acquisition of oil and gas properties.
-- Aftermarket Technology Corp shares jumped to 17-1/8 from their IPO price of $13.50 each. The company remakes drive train products for automobiles.
